00db8b5695fd.en: Eiri, on the other side of the bathroom, held the towel with one hand near her head, ready to throw. “I’ve seen those before—you got nothing to hide. Here. Catch it!”
00db8b5695fd.t: Eiri, di sebelah sana bilik mandi, memegang tuala itu dengan sebelah tangan berhampiran kepalanya, bersedia untuk membaling. “Aku dah pernah nampak benda tu—kau tak ada apa nak disorok. Nah. Tangkap!”

0617cccd8838.en: “No! I know you two can market pretty much anything, but—the question is, why though? We could just have a guard do that, and name him Sanbi-eye. I mean, why are we going through all this hurdle when the person is not even close to what Maiara wanted? We should just let him be free, and be done with it!”
0617cccd8838.t: “Tak! Aku tahu korang berdua boleh pasarkan hampir apa saja, tapi—soalannya, kenapa? Kita boleh je suruh seorang pengawal buat, dan namakan dia Sanbi-eye. Maksud aku, kenapa kita lalui semua halangan ni sedangkan orang tu langsung tak dekat dengan apa yang Maiara nak? Kita patut bebaskan je dia, dan habis cerita!”

066e22723d20.en: Eiri went back on her feet, and walked to the writing desk where she pulled out a single nari stone encased in green wood. “You grind this down, mix with someone’s body part, parts, or even pieces of the whole body, and that’s about it—or if you are smart enough like Gabiro, you can even customize it by mixing multiple people, or things. Then if you drink it, your body will change.”
066e22723d20.t: Eiri kembali berdiri, dan berjalan ke meja tulis di mana dia mengeluarkan sebutir batu nari yang dibungkus kayu hijau. “Kau kisar benda ni, campur dengan bahagian badan seseorang, beberapa bahagian, atau malah kepingan seluruh badan, dan itu saja—atau kalau kau cukup pandai macam Gabiro, kau boleh juga ubah suai dengan mencampurkan beberapa orang, atau benda. Lepas tu kalau kau minum, badan kau akan berubah.”

0d8d6de3268a.en: “And you’ve attempted to revive him through all normal means?” Neferteri looked at Eiri’s reaction rather than Kibe’s.
0d8d6de3268a.t: “Dan anda telah cuba menghidupkannya semula melalui semua cara biasa?” Neferteri memandang reaksi Eiri dan bukannya reaksi Kibe.

0ef99597a51e.en: Chapter III subchapter 2: the blonde girl adjusts the gold collar of Harry's new blue uniform.
0ef99597a51e.t: Bab III subbab 2: gadis berambut perang membetulkan kolar emas pakaian seragam biru baharu Harry.

18b6ae02ee52.en: “Wakey-wakey!” Eiri, speaking under her breath, reached towards the lukewarm, soapy water Harry slept in, and unclenched her fingers, making the white rings…
18b6ae02ee52.t: “Bangun, bangun!” Eiri, bercakap perlahan, mencapai air bersabun yang suam tempat Harry tertidur, dan membuka genggaman jarinya, membuatkan gelang-gelang putih…

192f999bd763.en: Harry stood there, with a slightly open mouth, apparently not being able to take in all the info dump.
192f999bd763.t: Harry berdiri di situ, mulut sedikit terbuka, nampaknya tidak mampu menghadam semua lambakan maklumat itu.

1b10dd08d637.en: “She said fuck it!” Itagiba bent forwards, now using his arms to rest his weight on the table. Letting out a chuckle, he continued, “Or if you want a direct quotation, she said she would fuck him up the ass tomorrow.”
1b10dd08d637.t: “Dia kata lantaklah!” Itagiba membongkok ke depan, kini menggunakan lengannya untuk menampung berat badan di atas meja. Tergelak kecil, dia menyambung, “Atau kalau kau nak petikan terus, dia kata dia akan liwat dia esok.”

1cd2cc861371.en: With a slight smile, and just as firm of a tone as before, Neferteri placed her hand on her husband’s desk. “We are the monarchy department, and it is our responsibility to handle the social interactions. Any tributary questions that may arise will be relayed over to your department as necessary.”
1cd2cc861371.t: Dengan senyuman kecil, dan nada yang sama tegas seperti tadi, Neferteri meletakkan tangannya di atas meja suaminya. “Kami jabatan monarki, dan menjadi tanggungjawab kami untuk mengendalikan interaksi sosial. Sebarang soalan tentang ufti yang mungkin timbul akan disampaikan kepada jabatan anda mengikut keperluan.”

1f710fe1599b.en: “Hi—I’m Harry.” With a defensive tone, Harry replied, still shivering as he took solace in the protection of the towel.
1f710fe1599b.t: “Hai—saya Harry.” Dengan nada defensif, Harry menjawab, masih menggigil sambil berlindung di sebalik tuala.

23cab9b1d784.en: With a deep breath, she let go of his pinky, and wore her yellow glove again. In her mind, a picture of a past meeting between her, Itagiba, Neferteri, and Gabiro flashed by. “You know how they told you were from the Sanbi slums?”
23cab9b1d784.t: Dengan tarikan nafas dalam, dia melepaskan jari kelingking Harry, dan memakai semula sarung tangan kuningnya. Dalam fikirannya, gambaran mesyuarat lalu antara dirinya, Itagiba, Neferteri dan Gabiro terimbas. “Kau tahu macam mana mereka kata kau berasal dari setinggan Sanbi?”

24be3728cff3.en: Eiri, meanwhile, grabbed a small rod with a fishing hook in one end from a drawer, and stuck it into the bathtub, causing a loud grumble to ensue when she fished out a big cork.
24be3728cff3.t: Eiri, sementara itu, mengambil sebatang rod kecil dengan mata kail di satu hujung dari laci, dan mencucuknya ke dalam tab mandi, menyebabkan bunyi berdeguk kuat menyusul apabila dia mengail keluar sebiji gabus besar.

26f96e4ac9f3.en: “Pull it in!” Eiri softly slapped his gut, contemplating with serious lips. Here he goes again talking about strange things.
26f96e4ac9f3.t: “Kempiskan!” Eiri menampar perutnya perlahan, merenung dengan bibir serius. Dia mula lagi cakap pasal benda pelik.

2a6d1d4ab761.en: A raspy voice, slightly above monotone, found its way out of Kibe’s mouth. “And do you think I wanted this?”
2a6d1d4ab761.t: Suara serak, sedikit di atas mendatar, keluar dari mulut Kibe. “Dan kau ingat aku nak semua ni?”

2a89fccd250f.en: His teeth chattering, Harry shivered again as his body hair stood up. “I—no—I did not—huh huh—try—”
2a89fccd250f.t: Giginya berlaga, Harry menggigil lagi sementara bulu romanya meremang. “Sa—tak—saya tak—huh huh—cuba—”

2b8a26aabedf.en: Eiri felt a tingle in her chest, an energy that she contained for a while now rising to the surface. “YES—BUT—THAT DOESN’T MAKE IT RIGHT!” Eiri felt a stroke of genius as her eyebrows regained some vitality “What about Maiara? This is clearly not what she wanted! Have you shown her Harry?”
2b8a26aabedf.t: Eiri merasakan getaran di dadanya, tenaga yang ditahannya sejak sekian lama naik ke permukaan. “YA—TAPI—ITU TAK BERMAKNA IA BETUL!” Eiri merasakan ilham genius ketika keningnya kembali bertenaga “Macam mana dengan Maiara? Ini jelas bukan apa yang dia nak! Awak dah tunjuk Harry kat dia?”

2c2ad6114161.t: “Tandas? Macam mana pula?” Rasa ingin tahu Eiri memuncak.

2cb62db25b59.en: Allowing time for Eiri to raise her badge, even though it was not necessary, Neferteri continued, “I also devised an initial handle of his situation as well. Courtroom scientist and king-maid, please notify your subordinates that he was in a lower floor recovering from the resuscitation, and that today’s events will not impact tomorrow’s.”
2cb62db25b59.t: Memberi masa kepada Eiri untuk mengangkat lencananya, walaupun ia tidak perlu, Neferteri menyambung, “Saya juga telah merangka pengendalian awal keadaannya. Saintis istana dan king-maid, sila maklumkan kepada orang bawahan anda bahawa dia berada di tingkat bawah sedang pulih daripada resusitasi, dan peristiwa hari ini tidak akan menjejaskan esok.”

315ba68dd82e.en: “Ohh! So that was their blood!” Harry interjected, with a sigh of relief.
315ba68dd82e.t: “Ohh! Jadi itu darah mereka!” Harry mencelah, dengan keluhan lega.

31ee15780c76.en: With his bad eyes, and reaction time, Harry’s hand failed to catch it mid-air, but lucky for him, it unfolded, and landed on his chest, then plopped on his feet.
31ee15780c76.t: Dengan matanya yang teruk, dan masa tindak balasnya, tangan Harry gagal menangkapnya di udara, tetapi nasib baik baginya, ia terbuka, dan mendarat di dadanya, kemudian jatuh ke kakinya.

32e2de58d4e7.en: Harry walked over to closely see what Eiri was holding, then grabbed it with both hands. “This one, yes, they are pants.” Amidst the struggle to put them on, he squirmed a few words. “Actually—I do know some things—but many of them feel weird, like the toilet.”
32e2de58d4e7.t: Harry berjalan mendekat untuk melihat dengan jelas apa yang Eiri pegang, kemudian mengambilnya dengan kedua-dua tangan. “Yang ni, ya, ini seluar.” Di tengah-tengah bergelut memakainya, dia mengeluarkan beberapa patah kata sambil menggeliat. “Sebenarnya—saya memang tahu sesetengah benda—tapi banyak yang terasa pelik, macam tandas tu.”

33e8a69ad636.en: “Yeah—like Itagiba told me what you remembered, so like—you know what this is, right?” Eiri gave him a pair of blue pants that looked a bit tight for his butt.
33e8a69ad636.t: “Ha—macam Itagiba bagi tahu aku apa yang kau ingat, jadi macam—kau tahu ni apa, kan?” Eiri memberinya sepasang seluar biru yang kelihatan agak ketat untuk punggungnya.

355cb363c260.en: With her arms crossed, Eiri rested herself against the blue door. “Something is clearly off. Two Freedays ago, in the meeting with all four, Itagiba asked Gabiro to create a new fake skin that matched what Maiara wanted—apply it on a random hobo, and see if Maiara fell in love with him, but earlier today I saw with my own two eyes they were doing something else. I don’t know exactly, but it all seemed odd from the beginning. I refused to accept it on the grounds that it would basically be a loveless marriage—but now seeing you I realized this might have been unfair to you as well.”
355cb363c260.t: Dengan tangan bersilang, Eiri bersandar pada pintu biru itu. “Ada sesuatu yang jelas tak kena. Dua Freeday lepas, dalam mesyuarat dengan keempat-empat mereka, Itagiba minta Gabiro cipta fake skin baru yang sepadan dengan apa yang Maiara nak—pakaikan pada mana-mana gelandangan, dan tengok sama ada Maiara jatuh cinta dengan dia, tapi tadi aku nampak dengan mata kepala aku sendiri mereka tengah buat benda lain. Aku tak tahu dengan tepat, tapi semuanya nampak pelik dari awal. Aku enggan terima atas alasan ia pada dasarnya perkahwinan tanpa cinta—tapi sekarang tengok kau, aku sedar ini mungkin tak adil untuk kau juga.”

396670df6bc5.en: A shrug came out of him. “It’s not my fault. I was just following orders—”
396670df6bc5.t: Kibe mengangkat bahu. “Bukan salah aku. Aku cuma ikut arahan—”

3a9f0f2ea0ac.en: Neferteri softly cleared her throat, carefully glancing at Eiri’s rhythmically shaking leg, then at the paper resting in her lap. Her eyes seemed to take keen note of the slightly crumpled nature of it, as if someone had held it a bit too tightly.
3a9f0f2ea0ac.t: Neferteri berdehem perlahan, mengerling dengan teliti kaki Eiri yang bergoyang berirama, kemudian kertas yang terletak di ribanya. Matanya kelihatan mengambil perhatian yang serius tentang keadaannya yang sedikit renyuk, seolah-olah seseorang memegangnya terlalu kuat.

3cef2c09b333.en: Feeling like something was stuck in the back of her throat, Eiri gulped, then slowly and rhythmically breathed. Okay. This is getting weirder. Sitting across from her, behind a large wooden desk was Neferteri, carefully reading a contract written in red ink, and signed in her own blood on the bottom left. Itagiba, to her left, lay back in his comfy red chair, with a relaxed brow, and a slight smile on his face. His eyes crossed paths with Eiri’s where they kept staring at each other for a few seconds, before Eiri deviated her attention to the meeting notes she was holding. Kibe, meanwhile, was nearly invisible in the room, like a chameleon on a tree branch—immobile and with a dead look in his eyes that zoomed around aimlessly. Eiri spoke up, interrupting a brief moment of silence. “Lemme see if I got this right. If he loses, then he’s gonna be five hundred sapphires in the hole, and will have to work as Sanbi-eye, which is basically going around listening to people’s complaints—isn’t that—like—the job of a guard? They already go on expeditions around the villages!”
3cef2c09b333.t: Merasakan seolah-olah ada sesuatu tersekat di belakang kerongkongnya, Eiri menelan liur, kemudian bernafas perlahan-lahan dan berirama. Okey. Makin pelik ni. Duduk bertentangan dengannya, di sebalik meja kayu besar ialah Neferteri, membaca dengan teliti sebuah kontrak yang ditulis dengan dakwat merah, dan ditandatangani dengan darahnya sendiri di bahagian bawah kiri. Itagiba, di sebelah kirinya, bersandar di kerusi merahnya yang selesa, dengan dahi yang santai, dan senyuman kecil di wajahnya. Matanya bertembung dengan mata Eiri dan mereka terus berpandangan selama beberapa saat, sebelum Eiri mengalihkan perhatiannya kepada nota mesyuarat yang dipegangnya. Kibe, sementara itu, hampir tidak kelihatan dalam bilik itu, seperti sesumpah di dahan pokok—tidak bergerak dan dengan pandangan mati di matanya yang melilau tanpa arah. Eiri bersuara, memecah kesunyian seketika. “Biar aku tengok kalau aku faham betul-betul. Kalau dia kalah, dia akan berhutang lima ratus sapphire, dan kena kerja sebagai Sanbi-eye, yang pada dasarnya merayau dengar aduan orang—bukan ke itu—macam—kerja pengawal? Mereka dah pun buat ekspedisi sekeliling kampung-kampung!”

40aa123545b4.en: An elegant, yet sharp womanly voice contrasted Itagiba's chill vibes. “I will not allow a sunk-cost fallacy to be used in this context for there are still benefits that will be derived from employing him on said project.” Neferteri poured a bucket of ice water over the conversation.
40aa123545b4.t: Suara wanita yang anggun namun tajam bertentangan dengan getaran santai Itagiba. “Saya tidak akan membenarkan kekeliruan kos tenggelam digunakan dalam konteks ini kerana masih ada manfaat yang akan diperoleh dengan menggajinya untuk projek tersebut.” Neferteri menyimbah sebaldi air ais ke atas perbualan itu.

467e2c32d5e6.en: “All right. I will get something from the top-shelf for you. I know just the right thing to lift your spirit.” Eiri opened the door. “By the way, if Sora works up the courage to come, can you please go easy on her?”
467e2c32d5e6.t: “Okey. Aku akan ambil sesuatu dari rak atas untuk kau. Aku tahu benda yang paling sesuai untuk naikkan semangat kau.” Eiri membuka pintu. “By the way, kalau Sora kumpul keberanian untuk datang, boleh tak kau jangan keras sangat dengan dia?”

46f08811c35e.en: With the door behind her, she took a second to catch a deep breath. Under her breath, she softly spoke, “That was the right thing.”
46f08811c35e.t: Dengan pintu di belakangnya, dia mengambil sesaat untuk menarik nafas dalam. Dengan suara perlahan, dia berkata lembut, “Itu perkara yang betul.”

47599b97f4b9.en: “I was a floor below doing my weekly check when I heard an explosion—” Eiri noticed Harry’s eyes dilate like a deer about to be hit by a truck. “—yeah. It sounded like one, but the building itself didn’t blow up. I rushed in, and I saw you unconscious on the table while Kibe was dead by the window, and Gabiro was on the grass outside, flat as a pancake—”
47599b97f4b9.t: “Aku kat tingkat bawah buat pemeriksaan mingguan bila aku dengar letupan—” Eiri perasan mata Harry membesar seperti rusa yang hendak dirempuh trak. “—ha. Bunyinya macam letupan, tapi bangunan tu sendiri tak meletup. Aku bergegas masuk, dan aku nampak kau tak sedarkan diri atas meja sementara Kibe dah mati kat tepi tingkap, dan Gabiro kat atas rumput kat luar, penyek macam lempeng—”

4a81d21b55aa.en: “Don’t you know how to rinse or what? Do it. Take a dip!” Eiri stood up by the bathtub, blocking his way out.
4a81d21b55aa.t: “Kau tak tahu bilas ke apa? Buat. Selam!” Eiri berdiri di tepi tab mandi, menghalang jalan keluarnya.

4ba4b94ad603.en: “Nooo—? At least I don’t remember meeting them?” Harry looked at Eiri, as he struggled to close the buttons. “Actually—I don’t remember being from the slums at all. I thought I had my own home, and—and—car! Yeah. I had a car! A black one!”
4ba4b94ad603.t: “Belummm—? Sekurang-kurangnya saya tak ingat jumpa mereka?” Harry memandang Eiri, sambil bergelut mengancing butang. “Sebenarnya—saya langsung tak ingat berasal dari setinggan. Saya ingat saya ada rumah sendiri, dan—dan—kereta! Ha. Saya ada kereta! Warna hitam!”

4f7fd3fa1a35.en: Harry followed suit, taking a deep breath, he submerged.
4f7fd3fa1a35.t: Harry menurut, menarik nafas dalam-dalam, dia menyelam.

4faac00cd412.en: Chapter III - Being Fair · Vol 1 - Failed Experiment · #HusbandOutWorld
4faac00cd412.t: Bab III - Berlaku Adil · Jilid 1 - Eksperimen Gagal · #HusbandOutWorld

51bbd2840a04.en: Pulling as far as he could, Harry gave just enough way for Eiri to tie in the buttons. Relaxing his gut afterwards, his stomach barreled against the buttons. The buttons themselves held firm in place, but the sewing around them was moments away from tearing and launching them into orbit, possibly on an escape trajectory.
51bbd2840a04.t: Mengempiskan sebanyak yang dia mampu, Harry memberi ruang yang cukup untuk Eiri mengancing butang. Melepaskan perutnya selepas itu, perutnya menghentam butang-butang itu. Butang-butang itu sendiri kekal teguh di tempatnya, tetapi jahitan di sekelilingnya hanya beberapa saat lagi untuk koyak dan melancarkannya ke orbit, mungkin dalam trajektori melarikan diri.

51d66e46c5cf.en: Chapter III subchapter 3: a meeting at a desk with a dark-haired woman, a man leaning back, the blonde girl and the silver-haired man.
51d66e46c5cf.t: Bab III subbab 3: satu mesyuarat di meja dengan seorang wanita berambut gelap, seorang lelaki bersandar, gadis berambut perang dan lelaki berambut perak.

57323c97d4e1.en: Closely observing how Harry portrayed driving a car, Eiri tried to imagine him in the top of a wagon, directing an egua—a horse-looking mammal, but bigger, and with tons of hair around the hoof region, but in her mind she couldn’t quite fit it together. “I have never seen a wagon, or carriage like that—I knew Sora told me the truth, but hearing it for myself really puts it into perspective.” Eiri’s lips thinned out, and her eyes dropped. “Did you sign a contract already?”
57323c97d4e1.t: Memerhati dengan teliti bagaimana Harry menggambarkan memandu kereta, Eiri cuba membayangkannya di atas kereta kuda, mengemudi seekor egua—mamalia yang kelihatan seperti kuda, tetapi lebih besar, dan dengan banyak bulu di sekitar bahagian kuku, tetapi dalam fikirannya dia tidak dapat menyesuaikannya. “Aku tak pernah nampak kereta kuda, atau gerabak macam tu—aku tahu Sora cakap benar, tapi bila dengar sendiri memang lain rasanya.” Bibir Eiri menipis, dan matanya jatuh. “Kau dah tandatangan kontrak?”

59b477f9a900.en: “You ready?” Eiri put the rod aside and grabbed the water handle attached to the pipe.
59b477f9a900.t: “Kau dah sedia?” Eiri meletakkan rod itu ke tepi dan memegang pemegang air yang dipasang pada paip.

5a76f54a4d36.en: Harry, hiding most of his body behind the towel, was frozen in place. No words came out of him.
5a76f54a4d36.t: Harry, menyembunyikan sebahagian besar tubuhnya di sebalik tuala, membeku di tempatnya. Tiada kata-kata yang keluar daripadanya.

5c4e55540fc5.en: So that’s how this is going to be? Fine. Not like I have a better plan anyway. She took out hers from in between her breasts and showed it as well.
5c4e55540fc5.t: Jadi macam ni la jadinya? Baiklah. Bukannya aku ada rancangan yang lebih baik pun. Dia mengeluarkan lencananya dari celah buah dadanya dan menunjukkannya juga.

5c6ceb51018a.en: Eiri stuck his pinky out as she was closing the door, “Remember the promise.”
5c6ceb51018a.t: Eiri menghulurkan jari kelingkingnya sambil menutup pintu, “Ingat janji tu.”

5ec5b7812f81.en: “Why? He’s a nobody! He has no idea who he is! Why are you presenting him with a choice when he does not know any alternatives?” Eiri replied back in a similar sharpness. “By the way—tier one daily salary is close to twelve pearls, which first—that’s terrible pay for what amounts to a guard, and second— that would put Harry—” using her fingers as a rough abacus, she counted a few big numbers, “Thirty-eight? No. Thirty-nine years! That’s how long he would be stuck with this unfair contract! I refuse to agree with that!”
5ec5b7812f81.t: “Kenapa? Dia bukan sesiapa! Dia tak tahu pun siapa dirinya! Kenapa awak bagi dia pilihan sedangkan dia tak tahu apa-apa alternatif?” Eiri membalas dengan ketajaman yang serupa. “By the way—gaji harian peringkat satu hampir dua belas Pearl, yang pertama—itu gaji yang teruk untuk kerja yang tak lebih daripada pengawal, dan kedua— itu akan buatkan Harry—” menggunakan jarinya sebagai sempoa kasar, dia mengira beberapa nombor besar, “Tiga puluh lapan? Bukan. Tiga puluh sembilan tahun! Selama itulah dia akan terperangkap dengan kontrak yang tak adil ni! Aku enggan setuju dengan tu!”

5f211de37d81.en: With a heavy breath, Eiri continued. “Like—I refused to allow it, but three against one means I had no choice but to accept defeat. Then Gabiro talked back saying he didn’t have time for this Sanbi shit, but soon after he suddenly changed his tune, and just asked when, to which Itagiba said it would be by next Gannday—today.”
5f211de37d81.t: Dengan nafas berat, Eiri menyambung. “Macam—aku enggan benarkan, tapi tiga lawan satu maknanya aku tak ada pilihan selain terima kekalahan. Lepas tu Gabiro membalas kata dia tak ada masa untuk urusan jiwa tua Sanbi ni, tapi tak lama lepas tu tiba-tiba dia tukar rentak, dan cuma tanya bila, dan Itagiba kata menjelang Gannday depan—hari ni.”

6531179639a8.en: “Pinky promise! I know this!” Harry ecstatically replied, looking Eiri in her green eyes.
6531179639a8.t: “Janji kelingking! Saya tahu yang ni!” Harry menjawab dengan teruja, memandang tepat ke mata hijau Eiri.

6582d39b9054.en: “I don’t know either!” With pouting lips, a sad tone slipped out of her mouth. “I got out-voted in the end. Just consider things carefully. If they offer you a contract, just read it thoroughly. Make sure that’s what you want. You can try to bargain for things, too.” Eiri placed her hands on the doorknob. “That’s all I have to say. For now, stay here, read a book—I recommend ‘Fanged Love’ if you like romance, or read ‘Prosperity Treaty’s Heroes’ if you like history—or maybe ‘The Sapphire Counter’ if you like accounting. I can even teach you some tricks of the trade if you do enjoy that book!” Eiri winked. “Any last questions?”
6582d39b9054.t: “Aku pun tak tahu!” Dengan bibir memuncung, nada sedih terlepas dari mulutnya. “Akhirnya aku kalah undi. Fikirlah baik-baik. Kalau mereka tawarkan kau kontrak, baca betul-betul. Pastikan itu yang kau nak. Kau boleh cuba tawar-menawar juga.” Eiri meletakkan tangannya pada tombol pintu. “Itu saja yang aku nak cakap. Buat masa ni, duduk sini, baca buku—aku cadangkan ‘Fanged Love’ kalau kau suka cerita cinta, atau baca ‘Prosperity Treaty’s Heroes’ kalau kau suka sejarah—atau mungkin ‘The Sapphire Counter’ kalau kau suka perakaunan. Aku boleh ajar kau beberapa helah juga kalau kau seronok baca buku tu!” Eiri mengenyit mata. “Ada soalan terakhir?”

6a33181e9e99.en: Eiri, using a feather, wrote yes three-to-one under Harry's final contract heading, then she read out loud the last heading in the paper. “The last topic is—Gabiro.” Eiri folded the slightly crumpled paper in half, and covered it with her hands, hiding it away from Neferteri’s prying eyes.
6a33181e9e99.t: Eiri, menggunakan bulu pena, menulis ya tiga lawan satu di bawah tajuk Kontrak muktamad Harry, kemudian dia membaca dengan kuat tajuk terakhir di kertas itu. “Topik terakhir ialah—Gabiro.” Eiri melipat kertas yang sedikit renyuk itu separuh, dan menutupnya dengan tangannya, menyembunyikannya dari mata Neferteri yang mengintip.

6bb0bfd1e4c8.en: “What gives? Are you trying to use your soul death as an excuse to woo my little Sora?” Eiri stood up, washed her hands, then grabbed a towel to dry them.
6bb0bfd1e4c8.t: “Apa hal ni? Kau cuba guna mati jiwa kau sebagai alasan nak memikat Sora aku ke?” Eiri berdiri, mencuci tangannya, kemudian mengambil tuala untuk mengeringkannya.

6c12bd62b023.en: Eiri placed back the badge in the depths between her breasts. “Anyway—you still remember the room you woke up in?”
6c12bd62b023.t: Eiri meletakkan semula lencana itu ke celah buah dadanya. “Apa-apa pun—kau masih ingat bilik tempat kau tersedar?”

732538eda6ff.en: Eiri clenched her teeth, then asked, “Then why do you want to have full control over him? What if citizens have tributary questions?”
732538eda6ff.t: Eiri mengetap gigi, kemudian bertanya, “Habis tu kenapa awak nak kawalan penuh ke atas dia? Macam mana kalau rakyat ada soalan tentang ufti?”

75a49a8a355a.en: While Itagiba eloquently quoted the second princess Maiara, Neferteri tightly closed her eyes as the rest of her face kept its usual elegance. Apparently ignoring Itagiba’s verbiage, she spoke in a firmer tone, “With everything stated thus far, all agreed on the final contract?” Neferteri raised her badge—its bioluminescent thermometer-like apparatus felt like an ultimatum for the others to act upon. Itagiba went next, and last was Kibe.
75a49a8a355a.t: Sementara Itagiba memetik dengan petah puteri kedua Maiara, Neferteri memejamkan matanya rapat-rapat sementara bahagian lain wajahnya mengekalkan keanggunan biasanya. Nampaknya tidak mengendahkan kata-kata Itagiba, dia bercakap dengan nada yang lebih tegas, “Dengan segala yang telah dinyatakan setakat ini, semua bersetuju dengan kontrak muktamad?” Neferteri mengangkat lencananya—alat seperti termometer yang berpendar itu terasa seperti kata dua untuk yang lain bertindak. Itagiba menyusul, dan yang terakhir ialah Kibe.

763382069cf5.en: “I don’t know. I don’t remember anything, and he did not write it down either. What do you want me to do?” Kibe appeared like a dog standing in front of an empty bowl, awaiting his master to throw him a bone—at least based on how he looked towards Neferteri.
763382069cf5.t: “Entahlah. Aku tak ingat apa-apa, dan dia tak tulis apa-apa juga. Apa yang awak nak aku buat?” Kibe kelihatan seperti anjing yang berdiri di depan mangkuk kosong, menunggu tuannya membaling tulang—sekurang-kurangnya berdasarkan cara dia memandang Neferteri.

791849f9aea0.en: With a loose jaw, and furrowed brows, Harry understood the words she was saying, but the meaning of it all was somewhat of a blur, just like his vision. He closed his eyes, and massaged his temple, “So I’m a random hobo from the slums? Then—then what fake skin is?”
791849f9aea0.t: Dengan rahang terlopong, dan dahi berkerut, Harry faham perkataan yang diucapkannya, tetapi makna semuanya agak kabur, sama seperti penglihatannya. Dia memejamkan mata, dan mengurut pelipisnya, “Jadi saya ni gelandangan rawak dari setinggan? Lepas tu—lepas tu fake skin tu apa?”

7a22b3e3f0a1.en: Harry aimlessly looked at the plethora of books in his room. He let out a long soft hum.
7a22b3e3f0a1.t: Harry memandang tanpa arah lambakan buku di biliknya. Dia berdengung panjang dan perlahan.

7b5f54235d4d.en: Harry, trying to remove the soap in his eyes, sat up in the quickly draining bathtub, but the sheer amount of soap made it impossible to get his vision back.
7b5f54235d4d.t: Harry, cuba membuang sabun di matanya, duduk dalam tab mandi yang airnya cepat surut, tetapi banyaknya sabun membuatkan mustahil untuk penglihatannya kembali.

7eb6a72b0e7b.en: “Shhh—we're good, bud!” Itagiba waved his hand close to his own neck, telling Kibe to cut the conversation short.
7eb6a72b0e7b.t: “Shhh—kita okey, bro!” Itagiba melambaikan tangannya dekat lehernya sendiri, menyuruh Kibe memendekkan perbualan.

831f0e63e970.en: The words cut through Eiri like butter, then a voice came to her head: That bitch, and her secrets! Argh! The voice was of her mother, Coema. Crossing her arms tightly, a pouting expression shone through her. She glanced towards Kibe, “You’re worse than Gabiro.”
831f0e63e970.t: Kata-kata itu menghiris Eiri seperti mentega, kemudian satu suara datang ke kepalanya: Perempuan sundal tu, dan rahsia-rahsia dia! Argh! Suara itu milik ibunya, Coema. Memeluk tubuh dengan erat, riak muncung terpancar daripadanya. Dia mengerling ke arah Kibe, “Kau lagi teruk daripada Gabiro.”

84d1e8948fae.en: “Contract? No? I—I don’t think so.” Harry responded openly to her tone growing serious.
84d1e8948fae.t: “Kontrak? Tak? Sa—saya rasa tak.” Harry menjawab dengan terbuka kepada nadanya yang semakin serius.

855467605d06.en: Chapter III subchapter 1: the blonde girl in a blue dress washes Harry as he relaxes in a bubbly bathtub.
855467605d06.t: Bab III subbab 1: gadis berambut perang bergaun biru memandikan Harry yang sedang bersantai dalam tab mandi berbuih.

864b19aebbbc.en: “Rinse yourself! Yeah! There you go! Get closer! There is still some soap on your hair!” Eiri, controlling the water handle, helped Harry rinse—or haze depending on who’s asking.
864b19aebbbc.t: “Bilas diri kau! Ha! Macam tu la! Dekat lagi! Masih ada sabun kat rambut kau!” Eiri, mengawal pemegang air itu, membantu Harry membilas—atau membuli, bergantung pada siapa yang ditanya.

86c8d59ce3d0.en: Harry was quietly mesmerized by the credit-card-sized object, feeling the remnants of warmth from being tucked away close to Eiri’s body. He felt the polished wood texture of the badge, and the indentations left behind by the wood carvings. He felt similar indentations on the back, and flipping the badge, he saw a circular logo stamped with fire. The logo was divided in four sections, each with a logogram. The top left was a mountain, then a grain, then the familiar looking fish, and finally, what appeared to be a weird horizontal genealogy tree. He pressed his thumb in the same base of the thermometer-like apparatuses Eiri pressed on, but no bioluminescence showed.
86c8d59ce3d0.t: Harry terpukau diam oleh objek sebesar kad kredit itu, merasakan sisa kehangatan kerana diselitkan rapat dengan tubuh Eiri. Dia merasakan tekstur kayu lencana yang digilap, dan lekukan yang ditinggalkan oleh ukiran kayu. Dia merasakan lekukan serupa di belakang, dan menterbalikkan lencana itu, dia nampak logo bulat yang dicap dengan api. Logo itu terbahagi kepada empat bahagian, setiap satu dengan logogram. Kiri atas ialah gunung, kemudian bijirin, kemudian ikan yang kelihatan biasa, dan akhir sekali, sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti salasilah keluarga mendatar yang pelik. Dia menekan ibu jarinya pada pangkal alat seperti termometer yang sama yang ditekan Eiri, tetapi tiada biopendarcahaya yang muncul.

876f1a9cf81f.en: Neferteri, slightly squinting towards her husband, took a deep breath. “For all we know right now, he has met the darkness, but publicly we will proclaim he is recovering from a lab accident involving breeding meatier Fanchakis. I will field the questions for a few weeks while Kibe continues to search for any hints on this matter. If nothing is found, then we shall publicly declare his soul died. Agreed?”
876f1a9cf81f.t: Neferteri, sedikit mengecilkan mata ke arah suaminya, menarik nafas dalam. “Setakat yang kita tahu sekarang, dia telah bertemu kegelapan, tetapi secara terbuka kita akan mengisytiharkan dia sedang pulih daripada kemalangan makmal melibatkan pembiakan Fanchaki yang lebih berisi. Saya akan menjawab soalan-soalan selama beberapa minggu sementara Kibe terus mencari sebarang petunjuk tentang perkara ini. Jika tiada apa-apa yang ditemui, maka kita akan mengisytiharkan secara terbuka bahawa jiwanya telah mati. Setuju?”

87763c3ed7e2.en: The gushing of water stopped, and with it the hazing rinse. Shivering as he sat up in the bathtub, he opened his eyes to the same blonde girl, opening a nearby drawer, and pulling out a blue with gold accented towel. Harry stood up with his hands in front of his privates, hiding the little that he had left to hide.
87763c3ed7e2.t: Curahan air berhenti, dan bersamanya bilasan buli itu. Menggigil sambil duduk dalam tab mandi, dia membuka matanya kepada gadis berambut perang yang sama, membuka laci berdekatan, dan mengeluarkan tuala biru berhias emas. Harry berdiri dengan tangan di hadapan kemaluannya, menyembunyikan sedikit yang masih tinggal untuk disembunyikan.

899e3f44beb6.en: Itagiba sat normally, and pointed a fingerbang right back at Kibe. With raised eyebrows, and a smirk on his face, as if he was making a move on a girl in a bar, he cheerfully said, “You tried your best, right?”
899e3f44beb6.t: Itagiba duduk seperti biasa, dan menunjuk balik ke arah Kibe dengan gaya tembakan jari. Dengan kening terangkat, dan senyum sinis di wajahnya, seolah-olah dia sedang memikat gadis di bar, dia berkata dengan ceria, “Kau dah cuba sedaya upaya, kan?”

8a795cedd67c.en: Eiri cut off Kibe, her voice more intense than usual. “—But—but you are the courtroom scientist now! You have the power to stop this!”
8a795cedd67c.t: Eiri memotong Kibe, suaranya lebih keras daripada biasa. “—Tapi—tapi kau saintis istana sekarang! Kau ada kuasa untuk hentikan ni!”

8ddf62c1e5c6.en: Eiri interrupted him, as she wore her yellow gloves. “—wash your hair already!”
8ddf62c1e5c6.t: Eiri memotongnya, sambil memakai sarung tangan kuningnya. “—cepatlah cuci rambut kau!”

92cf47521b17.en: “Yes? You wanted me to write those down? If so, Itagiba did not tell me to do that. I don’t even remember how many things I tried at this point. I even used Eori’s failed research on pickling,” Kibe pointed at Itagiba.
92cf47521b17.t: “Ya? Awak nak aku tuliskan semua tu? Kalau ya, Itagiba tak suruh aku buat macam tu. Aku pun dah tak ingat berapa banyak benda yang aku cuba setakat ni. Aku siap guna kajian gagal Eori pasal penjerukan,” Kibe menunjuk ke arah Itagiba.

936da81b32c7.en: Harry curled up, hugging his knees, he tried to save some body heat. “But—the soap.”
936da81b32c7.t: Harry meringkuk, memeluk lututnya, cuba menyimpan sedikit haba badan. “Tapi—sabun tu.”

952a4292747b.en: “Yeah—” With a forced cringe smile, Kibe replied rather monotonically. His eyes looked back and forth between the king and queen. “So what do you want me to know? I already masturb—”
952a4292747b.t: “Ha—” Dengan senyuman paksa yang menggelikan, Kibe menjawab agak mendatar. Matanya memandang silih berganti antara raja dan permaisuri. “Jadi apa yang awak nak aku tahu? Aku dah melanc—”

9a49ffe5f826.en: “C’mon. Don’t be shy. Both Maiara and Sora prefer men with more confidence than that,” Eiri called Harry with her hand. “Put the towel in the basket then come over here.” Eiri, now in the bedroom, peaked around the clothing drawers, looking for something. “Where did she put it? Ahh! There you go!” Eiri picked up a set of blueish clothes, with golden accents, plus  black underwear, blue socks, and brown social boots. She turned herself towards the bathroom door, where Harry stood up there, still hiding himself away in the towel, squinting his eyes back at her. “All right. Here!” Eiri mashed the underwear into a ball, and threw like a professional pitcher towards Harry.
9a49ffe5f826.t: “Alah. Jangan malu. Maiara dan Sora dua-dua suka lelaki yang lebih yakin daripada tu,” Eiri melambai Harry dengan tangannya. “Letak tuala dalam bakul lepas tu datang sini.” Eiri, kini di bilik tidur, menyelongkar almari pakaian, mencari sesuatu. “Mana dia letak? Ahh! Ni dia!” Eiri mengambil sepasang pakaian kebiruan, berhias emas, serta seluar dalam hitam, stokin biru, dan but formal coklat. Dia berpaling ke arah pintu bilik mandi, di mana Harry berdiri di situ, masih bersembunyi dalam tuala, mengecilkan mata memandangnya. “Okey. Nah!” Eiri menggumpal seluar dalam itu menjadi bola, dan membalingnya seperti pembaling profesional ke arah Harry.

a44dc71ee91c.en: “Gabiro would know. Ow? You haven’t met him? Not even Kibe?” Eiri saw the deadpan look in Harry’s eyes, hearing what appeared to be two completely foreign names.
a44dc71ee91c.t: “Gabiro mesti tahu. Eh? Kau belum jumpa dia? Kibe pun belum?” Eiri melihat pandangan kosong di mata Harry, mendengar apa yang kelihatan seperti dua nama yang sama sekali asing.

a57ccfc06ca2.en: Itagiba raised his badge, then Kibe did as well. They all looked at Eiri, forcibly gushing out air from her nose as the corners of her mouth held back much to say.
a57ccfc06ca2.t: Itagiba mengangkat lencananya, kemudian Kibe turut berbuat demikian. Mereka semua memandang Eiri, yang menghembus udara dari hidungnya dengan kuat sementara sudut mulutnya menahan banyak perkara untuk dikatakan.

a810a423ae98.en: “Yep. You were out cold, but alive, so I revived Kibe, and then we tried to revive Gabiro, but—” Eiri felt a tight chest. Holding one fist close to her chest, and a pained look on her face, she softly spoke, “—That’s when things went south. Gabiro somehow lit up in white fire, maybe soul fire, and then turned into a Fanchaki. Ahhhhh—Kibe still has no idea what happened, or how to turn Gabiro back. I had a suspicion they were messing with your soul, but right now I have no way to know what actually happened.”
a810a423ae98.t: “Ha’ah. Kau pengsan, tapi hidup, jadi aku hidupkan Kibe semula, lepas tu kami cuba hidupkan Gabiro semula, tapi—” Eiri merasakan dadanya sesak. Memegang sebelah penumbuk rapat ke dadanya, dan riak kesakitan di wajahnya, dia bercakap perlahan, “—Masa tulah semuanya jadi kacau. Gabiro entah macam mana menyala dalam api putih, mungkin api jiwa, lepas tu bertukar jadi Fanchaki. Ahhhhh—Kibe masih tak tahu apa yang jadi, atau macam mana nak ubah Gabiro balik. Aku syak mereka main-main dengan jiwa kau, tapi sekarang aku tak ada cara nak tahu apa yang sebenarnya berlaku.”

a83ccd3928b6.en: “Eiri—Eiri—my girl—you're missing the point! Listen!” Itagiba, cracking his neck, continued, “We can market the term Sanbi-eye!”
a83ccd3928b6.t: “Eiri—Eiri—budak aku—kau terlepas intipatinya! Dengar!” Itagiba, meletupkan lehernya, menyambung, “Kita boleh pasarkan istilah Sanbi-eye!”

a88e1ba9ab36.en: A smaller shrug came out of Kibe, but no actual response. His badge went down first, then the other two as a silence began building in the room.
a88e1ba9ab36.t: Kibe mengangkat bahu dengan lebih kecil, tetapi tiada jawapan sebenar. Lencananya turun dahulu, kemudian dua yang lain ketika kesunyian mula terbina dalam bilik itu.

af02fcacbea3.en: “What?” Harry, apparently still unwilling to open his eyes, blindly looked towards Eiri.
af02fcacbea3.t: “Apa?” Harry, nampaknya masih tidak mahu membuka mata, memandang buta ke arah Eiri.

b041c1caa61e.en: Eiri pulled out something from between her chest. An artifact about the size of a credit card. It had a green wood texture, with iron balls at the corners. The name Eiri Sanbi was written out in one line and Sanbi Royal in the next. Below it, there were two mercury thermometer-like apparatuses covered in dark grainy red. One was thinner, and displayed numbers 1 through 5 on its side, and the other was far thicker, and displayed numbers 6 through 10. The numbers from 1 to 5, and 6 to 10 were spaced using a rather precise logarithmic pattern, as if the space between 4 and 5, and 9 and 10 were much larger than 1 to 2, and 5 to 6. Eiri placed her thumb at the base of the pseudo thermometer, and like blood dripping and oozing onto a paper, a red bioluminescent light oozed itself from the base of the thinner thermometer, and propagated itself until somewhere around the halfway point between 4 and 5. “This is how you really know. A badge from Forway—which if I were to guess, you never had one either, right?” Eiri handed over the badge.
b041c1caa61e.t: Eiri mengeluarkan sesuatu dari celah dadanya. Satu artifak kira-kira sebesar kad kredit. Ia bertekstur kayu hijau, dengan bebola besi di bucu-bucunya. Nama Eiri Sanbi tertulis dalam satu baris dan Sanbi Royal di baris seterusnya. Di bawahnya, ada dua alat seperti termometer merkuri yang diliputi merah gelap berbutir. Satu lebih nipis, dan memaparkan nombor 1 hingga 5 di sisinya, dan satu lagi jauh lebih tebal, dan memaparkan nombor 6 hingga 10. Nombor 1 hingga 5, dan 6 hingga 10 dijarakkan menggunakan corak logaritma yang agak tepat, seolah-olah jarak antara 4 dan 5, dan 9 dan 10 jauh lebih besar daripada 1 hingga 2, dan 5 hingga 6. Eiri meletakkan ibu jarinya di pangkal termometer palsu itu, dan seperti darah yang menitis dan meresap ke atas kertas, cahaya biopendarcahaya merah meresap dari pangkal termometer yang lebih nipis, dan merebak sehingga ke suatu tempat sekitar pertengahan antara 4 dan 5. “Inilah cara kau benar-benar tahu. Lencana dari Forway—yang kalau aku teka, kau tak pernah ada pun, kan?” Eiri menghulurkan lencana itu.

b3993f343fcf.en: “In regard to the events that unfolded this morning, that is the sole responsibility of the courtroom scientist. There is a reason we have the monarchy, soul energy, and economical departments. We make requests to one another, and we hold each other accountable through this very meeting.” Neferteri did not mince words, looking elegant, yet combative with her unwavering will on full display.
b3993f343fcf.t: “Berkenaan peristiwa yang berlaku pagi tadi, itu tanggungjawab tunggal saintis istana. Ada sebabnya kita mempunyai jabatan monarki, tenaga jiwa dan ekonomi. Kita membuat permintaan antara satu sama lain, dan kita mempertanggungjawabkan satu sama lain melalui mesyuarat inilah.” Neferteri tidak berselindung, kelihatan anggun, namun bersedia bertarung dengan tekadnya yang tidak berganjak dipamerkan sepenuhnya.

b5426eab2753.en: “I don’t know. I thought you would press down on the top, or like a lever thingy on the side, but it’s not that.” Harry pressed a fictitious flush button. “Also, they aren’t supposed to be this boxy. I thought they would be more like an oval or something. White too.”
b5426eab2753.t: “Entahlah. Saya ingat kena tekan kat atas, atau macam tuil kat tepi, tapi bukan macam tu.” Harry menekan butang pam yang tidak wujud. “Lagi satu, ia tak sepatutnya berbentuk kotak macam ni. Saya ingat ia lebih macam bujur atau apa. Putih juga.”

b673c98b0455.en: A small grunt came out of Harry, still asleep. His body shifted around uncomfortably, then next came a bout of shiver. Suddenly, he opened his eyes to a blonde lady with green eyes who was bent forward, with her hands on the bathtub, staring him down with a grin. He defenselessly backed away towards the window.
b673c98b0455.t: Satu rengusan kecil keluar daripada Harry, masih tidur. Tubuhnya beralih-alih dengan tidak selesa, kemudian datang satu gigilan. Tiba-tiba, dia membuka matanya kepada seorang wanita berambut perang bermata hijau yang membongkok ke depan, dengan tangannya di tab mandi, merenungnya sambil tersengih. Dia berundur tanpa daya ke arah tingkap.

bac1164fff0c.en: Harry’s hands moved on their own to catch the towel going above his head, leaving exposed his shrunken manhood.
bac1164fff0c.t: Tangan Harry bergerak sendiri untuk menangkap tuala yang melayang di atas kepalanya, membiarkan kejantanannya yang mengecut terdedah.

bc7c4da0d6ba.en: With a firm nod, Harry looked serious in his confidence.
bc7c4da0d6ba.t: Dengan anggukan tegas, Harry kelihatan serius dalam keyakinannya.

bcb2565e284e.en: “Haaa!” A squeamish call came out of him, trying to keep the cold water at bay.
bcb2565e284e.t: “Haaa!” Jeritan geli-geleman keluar daripadanya, cuba menghalang air sejuk itu.

c4d59c84f4db.en: The same elegant voice from before cut through the ongoing conversation like a well-sharpened knife. “That’s enough. Our current topic is him—or am I wrong?”
c4d59c84f4db.t: Suara anggun yang sama tadi memotong perbualan yang sedang berlangsung seperti pisau yang diasah tajam. “Cukup. Topik kita sekarang ialah dia—atau saya silap?”

c86b21465b14.en: Eiri watched the one-man show of how to flush a toilet with intrigue in her eyes. “Never heard of that—that’s odd. I’ve heard of adventurers who were dead for like a month, losing pretty much all memories when they were revived—I heard one case where an amethyst adventurer basically became a baby! He couldn’t speak, stand up, and he even crapped his pants too.” Eiri chuckled, shaking her head as she unbuttoned a blue dress shirt with golden accents. “Like—can the person even be considered alive at that point?” With a wrinkling forehead, and a small sigh, she got closer to Harry. “Extend your hand.”
c86b21465b14.t: Eiri menonton pertunjukan seorang diri tentang cara mengepam tandas itu dengan minat di matanya. “Tak pernah dengar pula—peliknya. Aku pernah dengar pengembara yang dah mati macam sebulan, hilang hampir semua ingatan bila dihidupkan semula—aku pernah dengar satu kes di mana seorang pengembara amethyst pada dasarnya jadi bayi! Dia tak boleh bercakap, berdiri, malah dia berak dalam seluar juga.” Eiri tergelak kecil, menggeleng kepala sambil membuka butang kemeja biru berhias emas. “Macam—boleh ke orang tu dianggap hidup lagi pada tahap tu?” Dengan dahi berkerut, dan keluhan kecil, dia mendekati Harry. “Hulur tangan kau.”

c8bd790f8fc8.en: Harry nodded with a sad, busy smile splattered on his face.
c8bd790f8fc8.t: Harry mengangguk dengan senyuman sedih yang sibuk terpercik di wajahnya.

cb8b40757c9f.en: “Oh! we know.” Itagiba looked deeply at Eiri’s worried eyes with a cheerful grin, pulling out a paper from a pile of random papers he had on his desk. “I do have a copy of last meeting’s votes. See? Now we are just getting Kibe up to speed, and placing a vote on the amended contract before getting the Bagarisa guy to sign.”
cb8b40757c9f.t: “Oh! Kami tahu.” Itagiba memandang dalam-dalam mata Eiri yang risau dengan sengihan ceria, mengeluarkan sehelai kertas dari timbunan kertas rawak yang ada di atas mejanya. “Aku memang ada salinan undian mesyuarat lepas. Nampak? Sekarang kita cuma nak bagi Kibe faham keadaan, dan buat undian untuk kontrak yang dipinda sebelum suruh mamat Bagarisa tu tandatangan.”

cc43edc3150e.en: “Haha—so you’re a grower, huh?” Eiri placed her hands in the direction of the shriveled jewels, right before they disappeared again behind a fancy towel.
cc43edc3150e.t: “Haha—jadi kau jenis membesar, ya?” Eiri menghalakan tangannya ke arah permata yang mengecut itu, sebelum ia hilang semula di sebalik tuala yang mewah.

cf400875c2b0.en: “I know. I know. Take some time to think about it. In the meantime, I will ask a maid to stop by with some tea. Any preferences?”
cf400875c2b0.t: “Aku tahu. Aku tahu. Ambil masa untuk fikir. Sementara tu, aku akan minta seorang pembantu rumah singgah bawa teh. Ada pilihan?”

d0708a3903ba.en: “Hehehe—” Eiri pulled on the water handle, letting the cold water splash Harry.
d0708a3903ba.t: “Hehehe—” Eiri menarik pemegang air itu, membiarkan air sejuk menyimbah Harry.

d230ec168b10.en: Eiri firmly grasped Harry’s slightly cold pinky. He initially was soft in response, but then he grasped her pinky in a reciprocal strength.
d230ec168b10.t: Eiri menggenggam erat jari kelingking Harry yang agak sejuk. Pada mulanya dia lembik sebagai balasan, tetapi kemudian dia menggenggam jari kelingking Eiri dengan kekuatan yang setimpal.

d24fa8a5c9b2.en: Slowly shrugging, Harry looked back at Eiri, with another hum, but shorter this time.
d24fa8a5c9b2.t: Perlahan-lahan mengangkat bahu, Harry memandang semula Eiri, dengan satu lagi dengungan, tetapi lebih pendek kali ini.

d4975645e02d.en: Harry touched his chest, “Did I forget mine? Wait. What was the company badge again? It had my name—I think.”
d4975645e02d.t: Harry menyentuh dadanya, “Saya terlupa saya punya ke? Kejap. Lencana syarikat tu macam mana ya? Ada nama saya—rasanya.”

d5101fbaa44b.en: “I can’t quite remember it either, but I knew I sat on it with my hands like this, and if I stepped towards the right it would accelerate, and the middle would brake. There was this thing sticking out on the left that you would flick up or down, but I can’t remember what it did. I mean I know there’s more, but I can’t really remember it.” Harry performed another one-man show, with his hands stuck out front, including stepping on fictitious pedals.
d5101fbaa44b.t: “Saya tak berapa ingat juga, tapi saya tahu saya duduk dalamnya dengan tangan macam ni, dan kalau saya pijak ke kanan ia akan memecut, dan yang tengah untuk brek. Ada benda yang terjulur kat kiri yang awak petik ke atas atau ke bawah, tapi saya tak ingat fungsinya. Maksud saya saya tahu ada banyak lagi, tapi saya tak berapa ingat.” Harry membuat satu lagi pertunjukan seorang diri, dengan tangannya terjulur ke depan, termasuk memijak pedal yang tidak wujud.

d55fbd93b823.en: “Do you even have a badge?” Eiri’s tone was one where she was no longer playing around.
d55fbd93b823.t: “Kau ada lencana pun ke?” Nada Eiri ialah nada seseorang yang tidak lagi bermain-main.

d84be496c7ab.en: Eiri evaded his obnoxious grin, and looked at the human-chameleon called Kibe. “You’re the new courtroom scientist! Don’t you think this is wrong?”
d84be496c7ab.t: Eiri mengelak sengihan menjengkelkannya, dan memandang manusia-sesumpah bernama Kibe. “Kau saintis istana yang baru! Kau tak rasa ni salah ke?”

de4c8fa4abaf.en: Vaguely blinking, Harry spit out, “Wow—for real?—but then, how do you know what someone really looks like? What do I look like?”
de4c8fa4abaf.t: Berkelip-kelip samar, Harry terlepas cakap, “Wow—betul ke?—tapi kalau macam tu, macam mana nak tahu rupa sebenar seseorang? Rupa saya macam mana?”

e29ccbf748a9.en: Julia really did a good job with the sewing. Eiri, glancing at the nearly ripping fabric, spoke seriously. “So you're saying you had a car—what is that?”
e29ccbf748a9.t: Julia memang jahit dengan bagus. Eiri, mengerling fabrik yang hampir koyak itu, bercakap dengan serius. “Jadi kau kata kau ada kereta—apa benda tu?”

e40f41c481c9.en: With a smile, Eiri blew off Harry with her hand. “I’m just kidding—anyway, I’m Eiri—Sanbi’s King-Maid.”
e40f41c481c9.t: Dengan senyuman, Eiri mengibas tangannya kepada Harry. “Aku gurau je—apa-apa pun, aku Eiri—King-Maid Sanbi.”

e44cbfcfcc0b.en: Eiri crossed her arms, and looked back at them with a flimsily firmness, and a trembling corner of the mouth. She looked at the Sanbi king, Itagiba, and Sanbi queen, Neferteri. “Then tell me! What happened this morning? Why was Gabiro doing an experiment with the soul? Everyone knows how dangerous it is!”
e44cbfcfcc0b.t: Eiri memeluk tubuh, dan memandang mereka dengan ketegasan yang rapuh, dan sudut mulut yang menggeletar. Dia memandang raja Sanbi, Itagiba, dan permaisuri Sanbi, Neferteri. “Kalau macam tu bagi tahu aku! Apa yang jadi pagi tadi? Kenapa Gabiro buat eksperimen dengan jiwa? Semua orang tahu betapa bahayanya!”

e68057f4f1c0.en: Harry, in nothing but a pair of black underwear, appeared at the door, showing off his hairy gut. “Weird questions?”
e68057f4f1c0.t: Harry, hanya berseluar dalam hitam, muncul di pintu, menunjuk-nunjukkan perutnya yang berbulu. “Soalan pelik?”

e82ad34e2e6d.en: Neferteri pointed towards a small pile of books covered in fish leather, with a cyan fish logo painted on the covers. “Kibe, please give us a rundown of your attempts, plus an ETA.”
e82ad34e2e6d.t: Neferteri menunjuk ke arah timbunan kecil buku bersalut kulit ikan, dengan logo ikan biru kehijauan dilukis pada kulitnya. “Kibe, sila berikan kami ringkasan percubaan anda, serta anggaran masa siap.”

eef09f9a09aa.en: With an aura of superiority, Neferteri spoke up clearly, “In regard to him, and our previous meetings, I did not divulge the finalized contract due to the wide range of possible mental states, and capabilities he could awaken with. Given that he does not possess a strong personality and lacks knowledge about himself, I decided to use him for the Sanbi-eye project.” Neferteri’s eyes struck like daggers towards Eiri’s. “He is a nobody that we have given a golden ticket. Do you fathom how many citizens would stand at our doors wishing for such a thing?”
eef09f9a09aa.t: Dengan aura kelebihan diri, Neferteri bersuara dengan jelas, “Berkenaan dirinya, dan mesyuarat kita sebelum ini, saya tidak mendedahkan kontrak muktamad kerana pelbagai kemungkinan keadaan mental, dan kebolehan yang mungkin dimilikinya apabila tersedar. Memandangkan dia tidak mempunyai personaliti yang kuat dan tidak mengenali dirinya sendiri, saya memutuskan untuk menggunakannya untuk projek Sanbi-eye.” Mata Neferteri menikam seperti belati ke arah mata Eiri. “Dia bukan sesiapa yang telah kita berikan tiket emas. Tahukah anda berapa ramai rakyat yang akan berdiri di depan pintu kita mengharapkan perkara sebegitu?”

f25d4175d0cc.en: Harry nodded, eagerly listening to everything she was saying.
f25d4175d0cc.t: Harry mengangguk, mendengar dengan penuh minat segala yang dikatakannya.

f857020f9138.en: Harry, doing as told, saw Eiri’s yellow-gloved hands help put on the shirt. “So I was an adventurer instead? Itagiba said I had a near soul death, too, but I don’t even remember being in the slum—I do know what it is though—I think.”
f857020f9138.t: Harry, menurut, melihat tangan Eiri yang bersarung kuning membantu memakaikan kemeja itu. “Jadi saya pengembara rupanya? Itagiba kata saya hampir mati jiwa juga, tapi saya tak ingat pun berada kat setinggan—saya tahu apa itu setinggan—rasanya.”

fa456d7cd7b0.en: “But—but what should I do?” With a vague look in his eyes, Harry looked back at Eiri as if she was his savior, or a friend—maybe both.
fa456d7cd7b0.t: “Tapi—tapi apa saya patut buat?” Dengan pandangan kosong di matanya, Harry memandang Eiri seolah-olah dia penyelamatnya, atau kawan—mungkin kedua-duanya.

fa8b592c408f.en: “Wakey-wakey!” Eiri, speaking under her breath, reached towards the lukewarm, soapy water Harry slept in, and unclenched her fingers, making the white rings floating around her forearm all clash forward, infusing into her hand, and releasing into the water. Small pieces of ice crystals formed, but then sank alongside the colder water towards the bottom of the bathtub.
fa8b592c408f.t: “Bangun, bangun!” Eiri, bercakap perlahan, mencapai air bersabun yang suam tempat Harry tertidur, dan membuka genggaman jarinya, membuatkan gelang-gelang putih yang terapung di sekeliling lengan bawahnya semua berlaga ke depan, meresap ke dalam tangannya, dan terlepas ke dalam air. Kepingan-kepingan kecil kristal ais terbentuk, tetapi kemudian tenggelam bersama air yang lebih sejuk ke dasar tab mandi.

fad8923425fa.en: Eiri swallowed her words, and gripped the meeting notes she was holding. “Yes.” A regretful tone slipped out of her mouth. This is not going anywhere. I need to do something—
fad8923425fa.t: Eiri menelan kata-katanya, dan menggenggam nota mesyuarat yang dipegangnya. “Ya.” Nada kesal terlepas dari mulutnya. Ni tak ke mana. Aku kena buat sesuatu—

fc3a293b7a36.en: Eiri slowly opened the blue bedroom door, and spied out towards the stairs, confirming nobody was there listening in. She closed the door, removed her yellow glove, and stuck her pink finger out. “Promise not to say this to anyone, okay?”
fc3a293b7a36.t: Eiri perlahan-lahan membuka pintu bilik tidur yang biru, dan mengintai ke arah tangga, memastikan tiada sesiapa di situ yang mencuri dengar. Dia menutup pintu, menanggalkan sarung tangan kuningnya, dan menghulurkan jari kelingkingnya yang merah jambu. “Janji jangan cakap kat sesiapa, okey?”

ff8e93cd7e36.en: “That might be a bit tight for you, but that’s what I have right now. Sorry, I was told you would be leaner.” Eiri saw Harry hide away in the bathroom, with underwear in hands. “Sora told me about you—I heard of near soul deaths cases before, but people only lose memories, rather than them suddenly asking weird questions.”
ff8e93cd7e36.t: “Mungkin ketat sikit untuk kau, tapi itu je yang aku ada sekarang. Maaf, aku diberitahu kau lebih kurus.” Eiri melihat Harry bersembunyi di bilik mandi, dengan seluar dalam di tangan. “Sora dah cerita pasal kau—aku pernah dengar kes hampir mati jiwa sebelum ni, tapi orang cuma hilang ingatan, bukannya tiba-tiba tanya soalan pelik.”
